- Psychotherapies, such as CBT and third-wave CBT, are effective in reducing symptoms of GAD
- CBT is associated with greater effectiveness than treatment as usual in the long term
- Other treatments, such as relaxation therapy, may also be effective in the short term for GAD
- Antidepressants and quetiapine are also effective in treating GAD
- Internet-based psychological interventions can be useful for GAD treatment when face-to-face treatment is inaccessible
